All inputs are public. Each raw file's download date, size, checksum, and coverage are
recorded in
[`data/MANIFEST.json`](https://github.com/Gnanasudharsan/nyc-congestion-pricing-causal-impact/blob/main/data/MANIFEST.json).
Datasets that begin in January 2025 have no pre-period, so they are used only descriptively.

{{< include _generated/coverage.md >}}

## Rebuild

```bash
make setup     # pinned Python 3.12 environment (uv) + git hooks
make data      # download raw data, build and validate every panel (1-2 hours)
make analysis  # every design, check, and label -> results/ (about 2 hours)
make report    # this site and the PDF paper (requires Quarto)
```

The [data catalog](https://github.com/Gnanasudharsan/nyc-congestion-pricing-causal-impact/blob/main/docs/data-catalog.md)
documents every dataset ID, column meaning, and cleaning rule.
